comment: Data, not code. Dependency, build and cache paths each ecosystem creates, per language (keys match LANGS in scripts/wave0.py), plus `common`. wave0.py appends the missing entries of the plan's languages and `common` to .gitignore before any agent runs; checkpoint.py never blocks a task on a path matching the union of every list. A trailing slash marks a directory; `*` globs match one path segment. Edit this file to change what is ignored; no code change is needed.
